title: I tried to come to this thread in my dream
content: I’m on a cruise ship, but I can’t find my way to my room. Countless stairs, people, then I come to the two white elevators. I see them and blurt out, “Holy shit, I’m in it.” I go to open my phone to take a pic and post to this thread, but it’s like I can’t ever get to it or find the group, nor my camera app. I get on the janky elevators, followed by more stairs, more people, more long hallways and more janky elevators, make it to floor 3, but then my room number changes and I never make it to floor 5. Had to share before I forgot.
